description: Scaffold the @lhd/web Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript workspace and build the typed API client plus the domain-label utility, with unit tests. This is the foundation: it establishes a buildable app that transpiles the raw-TS @lhd/shared package, fetches all API data through one graceful, non-throwing client, and maps the 15 DevelopmentDomainKey enum values to readable labels. Depends on nothing; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on this.
steps: Create apps/web/package.json: name '@lhd/web', private, scripts dev='next dev -p 3000', build='next build', start='next start -p 3000', lint='next lint', test='vitest run'. dependencies: next ^15, react ^19, react-dom ^19. devDependencies: typescript ^5, @types/react ^19, @types/react-dom ^19, @types/node ^24, eslint ^9 (or the version eslint-config-next 15 expects), eslint-config-next ^15, vitest ^2, @testing-library/react ^16, @testing-library/jest-dom ^6, @testing-library/user-event ^14, jsdom ^25, @vitejs/plugin-react ^4. Add '@lhd/shared': '*' as a dependency so the workspace link resolves.
Create apps/web/next.config.mjs exporting a config with transpilePackages: ['@lhd/shared'] (required because @lhd/shared ships raw ESM TypeScript with no build step) and reactStrictMode: true.

Create apps/web/tsconfig.json suitable for Next 15 App Router (moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'preserve', strict true, plugins next). Include a paths entry mapping '@lhd/shared' to '../../packages/shared/src/index.ts' so the type import resolves in the editor and vitest. Create apps/web/next-env.d.ts.

Create apps/web/vitest.config.ts: use @vitejs/plugin-react, test.environment 'jsdom', test.globals true, setupFiles ['./vitest.setup.ts'], and resolve.alias mapping '@lhd/shared' to the absolute path of ../../packages/shared/src/index.ts so tests import the shared types. Create apps/web/vitest.setup.ts importing '@testing-library/jest-dom'.

Create a minimal placeholder apps/web/app/layout.tsx (semantic html/body + {children}) and apps/web/app/page.tsx so 'next build' succeeds at the end of this feature. (FEAT-002 fills in the real layout and pages.)

Create apps/web/lib/api.ts: read const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3001/api'. Export a discriminated result type Result<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string }. Implement getPhases(): Promise<Result<CatalogEntry[]>>, getPhase(idOrSlug: string): Promise<Result<Phase>>, askAssistant(question: string, token?: string): Promise<Result<AskResult>> (POST /ai/ask with Authorization bearer when token present), and optional login(email,password) / register(payload) returning Result<{ accessToken: string }>. Every call uses fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store', ... }) wrapped in try/catch; non-2xx and thrown network errors return { ok:false, error } — NEVER throw. Define a local AskResult interface { answer: string; routedToHuman: boolean; citations: { phaseId: string; citation: string }[] } (shape taken from apps/api ai.service.ts; do NOT import from apps/api). Import type { Phase, CatalogEntry, UserRole } from '@lhd/shared'.

Create apps/web/lib/domain-labels.ts: export a Record<DevelopmentDomainKey, string> (or a function) mapping all 15 keys to readable labels (e.g. 'physical-and-motor' -> 'Physical & motor', 'health-hygiene-self-care' -> 'Health, hygiene & self-care', 'respect-empathy-relationships' -> 'Respect, empathy & relationships', etc.) plus a labelForDomain(key: string): string helper that falls back to a title-cased version of an unknown key. Import type { DevelopmentDomainKey } from '@lhd/shared'.

Create apps/web/lib/__tests__/domain-labels.test.ts: assert every DevelopmentDomainKey resolves to a non-empty human label distinct from the raw key, and that labelForDomain('some-unknown-key') returns a sensible fallback.

Create apps/web/lib/__tests__/api.test.ts: stub global.fetch (vi.fn). Assert getPhases() calls '<base>/phases', getPhase('phase-01') calls '<base>/phases/phase-01', askAssistant('q','tok') POSTs '<base>/ai/ask' with the bearer header and JSON body { question:'q' }. Assert that when fetch rejects (network error) and when fetch resolves non-ok, each function returns { ok:false } and does NOT throw. Optionally assert NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL override is honoured.

Add two ADDITIVE scripts to the root package.json 'scripts' object WITHOUT removing or changing any existing entry (keep 'test' as 'npm run content:validate'): 'dev:web': 'npm --workspace @lhd/web run dev' and 'test:web': 'npm --workspace @lhd/web test'.
From the repo root run 'npm install' to link the new workspace.
acceptance_criteria: From repo root 'npm install' completes and links @lhd/web.
From apps/web 'npm run build' completes with 0 errors on the scaffold (API not running).
From apps/web 'npm test' passes: domain-labels covers all 15 keys + fallback; api.test covers URL building for phases/phase/ask and failed-fetch returning { ok:false } without throwing.
Root package.json still contains the original scripts including 'test' = 'npm run content:validate'; only dev:web and test:web were added.
verification: cd apps/web; npm run build  (expect: compiled successfully, 0 errors, with the API NOT running)
cd apps/web; npm test  (expect: all vitest tests pass)
From repo root: confirm package.json 'scripts.test' is unchanged and dev:web + test:web were added additively
findings:
DELIVERED & VERIFIED. apps/web Next.js 15 App Router scaffold builds, lints, and tests clean. (1) `npm install` from repo root links @lhd/web. (2) From apps/web `npm run build` = compiled successfully, 0 errors, API NOT running. (3) Root package.json scripts added ADDITIVELY: 'dev:web'='npm --workspace @lhd/web run dev', 'test:web'='npm --workspace @lhd/web test'; existing 'test'='npm run content:validate' and all others unchanged.

TEST RUNNER CHANGE (approved by parent, overriding the spec's Vitest mandate): Vitest CANNOT run in this workspace because the absolute path ends in '%' ('…Evaluation of Human 0 to 100%\'). Vite 5 calls decodeURI on the project root and a bare '%' throws 'URIError: URI malformed' (verified: node -e "decodeURI(process.cwd())" throws here), so 0 tests collect. The web app now uses JEST + React Testing Library via next/jest (jsdom), the same runner apps/api uses successfully through this same path. next build is unaffected. Files: jest.config.mjs (next/jest, testEnvironment jsdom, setupFilesAfterEnv ['<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts'], moduleNameMapper '^@lhd/shared$' -> '<rootDir>/../../packages/shared/src/index.ts'), jest.setup.ts imports '@testing-library/jest-dom'. vitest.config.ts / vitest.setup.ts were REMOVED. apps/web 'test' script = 'jest'. Note: @lhd/shared is type-only, so SWC erases those imports at compile time.

CONTRACTS FOR LATER FEATURES (used by FEAT-002/003):
- Installed versions: next@15.5.28, react@19, react-dom@19, typescript@5.7, eslint@9.39.5, eslint-config-next@15, jest@29.7, jest-environment-jsdom@29.7, @types/jest@29.5, @testing-library/react@16, @testing-library/jest-dom@6, @testing-library/user-event@14, @types/react@19, @types/react-dom@19, @types/node@24.
- API client apps/web/lib/api.ts. Result type: `export type Result<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string }`. Functions (async, NEVER throw): getPhases(): Result<CatalogEntry[]>; getPhase(idOrSlug): Result<Phase>; askAssistant(question, token?): Result<AskResult>; login(email,password): Result<{accessToken}>; register({email,password,role,displayName}): Result<{accessToken}>. AskResult (local, do NOT import from apps/api): { answer: string; routedToHuman: boolean; citations: { phaseId: string; citation: string }[] }. API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3001/api'. fetch(url,{cache:'no-store'}).
- Domain labels apps/web/lib/domain-labels.ts: DOMAIN_LABELS: Record<DevelopmentDomainKey,string> (all 15 keys) and labelForDomain(key: string): string (title-cased fallback).
- next.config.mjs: transpilePackages:['@lhd/shared'], reactStrictMode:true. tsconfig paths map '@lhd/shared' -> '../../packages/shared/src/index.ts'.
